description: Send the signed `test` event to one of the user's webhook channels again (ids from alerts_list_channels), for example after the receiver installed a new secret from alerts_register_webhook or alerts_rotate_webhook_secret. Signed like a real delivery: the current secret and, inside a rotation's 24 hours, the previous one too (two `sig=` values; accept if ANY matches). Returns {ok, channel_id, test}, where `test` is {ok, status} when the endpoint answered (ok = HTTP 2xx) or {ok: false, error: timeout | network | ssrf_refused | ...}. Nothing is queued, retried or stored.
name: alerts_test_webhook
title: Alerts Test Webhook
